## 📌 Description
Provide a concise description of the changes introduced in this Pull Request.

Fixes #(issue_number)

## 🛠️ Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `style`: Formatting or visual styling fix
- [ ] `refactor`: Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance, package dependencies, or build config

## 🧪 Verification & Testing
Describe the tests or checks performed to verify your changes:
- [ ] Ran `pnpm lint` without warnings/errors
- [ ] Ran `pnpm type-check` without TypeScript errors
- [ ] Tested locally on dev server (`pnpm dev`)
- [ ] Verified responsive layout on mobile, tablet, and desktop screens

## 📸 Screenshots / Visual Diffs (if applicable)
Add before/after screenshots or GIFs demonstrating UI changes.

## 🏁 Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's coding standards and naming conventions.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have updated documentation / README if applicable.
- [ ] My commit messages follow the Conventional Commits specification.
